headline: Comprehensive development plan for a mixed-use project at 260, 270, and 282 Loudon Road and 277 Sheep Davis Road.
summary: The plan includes about 600 apartments, about 329,200 square feet of commercial and retail space, a fueling station, and about 5,040 square feet of restaurant space. The meeting also covers Master Plan workshop items, including a subcommittee appointment and public engagement planning.

# City of Concord

Agenda · Planning Board · Monday, November 2, 2026 · 6:00 PM · City Council Chambers · 37 Green Street · Concord, NH 03301

The Board will hold a Nonpublic Session under RSA 91-A:3.II(c) at 6p.m.

1. Call to Order · 2. Roll Call · 3. Agenda Overview

## 4. Site Plan, Subdivision and Conditional Use Permit Applications

4A. Gallagher, Callahan, & Gartrell, PC, Jones and Beach Engineering, Inc, and Onyx

Partners, Ltd, on behalf of Onyx SteepleGate Concord, LLC, Onyx Regal Concord, LLC, and Onyx TD Concord, LLC, requests comprehensive development plan approval for the consolidation of condominium and resubdivision into separate lots and ownership, and a proposed mixed-use redevelopment to include certain on and offsite improvements, a fueling station, and approximately 600 residential unit apartments, approximately 329,200-square-feet of commercial/retail, and approximately 5,040 square-feet of restaurant use at Tax Maps: 611Z Lot 40 addressed as 270 Loudon Rd; 611Z Lot 39 addressed as 282 Loudon Rd; 61Z Lot 9 addressed as 277 Sheep Davis Rd 270; and, 611Z Lot 41 addressed as 260 Loudon Road, all within the Gateway Performance (GWP) District. (2026-041) (PL-CDP-2026-0002)
